children: ChronoScale Holdings entered into a First Amendment to its Secured Promissory Note and Security Agreement with B. Riley Commercial Capital. The amendment relates to a $2.0 million term loan, all of which is outstanding, and extends the maturity to Nov 12 2026 from the original 12-month term. It also deems a sale of guarantor Ekso Bionics, on specified terms, a permitted disposition. All other material terms remain unchanged.
: First Amendment to Secured Promissory Note and Security Agreement (term loan)
: Extend maturity and allow potential sale of guarantor
